_about: Runetta (111153, flame_blessgirl): translated from the game's Japanese. Global names: Nimbus (Shiro), Shywe, Challua, Pur Lilie, Palpebra, Starview Village.
profile: A newbie adventurer from the countryside. She harbors the power of a fire spirit, though even she doesn't really know why. But she doesn't sweat the details. Armed with the spirit's power and her natural cheerfulness, she charges down the path to becoming a first-class adventurer.
titleCondition: Level Runetta to 100 and obtain her Amity Scroll

speech.home/sasugawa: Palpebra really is something! It's totally different from my hometown! Big buildings! Paved roads! So this is the big city!! ...Huh? This is Shibuya? Fweh?
speech.home/seireisan_seireisan: Mister Spirit? ...Mister Spiriiit? ...Yeah, I can't hear a voice or anything. Why does it lend me its power...? Hmm, maybe I'll go ask Shywe?
speech.home/zatsuyodemo: Leave anything to me, even chores! It's all part of becoming a first-class adventurer! With my power...! I can even dry the laundry faster!!
speech.home/komatteiru: If anyone's in trouble, leave it to me! I won't turn a blind eye to anyone! After all, I set out to become an adventurer to stop people's tears...!
speech.home/dodesuka_alksan: How about it, Alk? Alk! I've gotten closer to first-class, right!? ...Ehehe! I'll keep training even harder!
speech.home/a_shirosan: Oh, Nimbus! I'm gonna punch you for real, so punch me back! Let's have a heart-to-heart with our fists! ...Huh? Why are you running away!?
speech.ally/join: Yes! I'm Runetta, a newbie adventurer! I'm still inexperienced, but I'll give it my all to become a first-class adventurer! It's a pleasure to meet you!
speech.ally/evolution: Have I gotten a little closer to the first-class adventurer I'm aiming to be...? I don't know, but I'll keep trying! To stop people's tears!

1.title: Newbie Adventurer of Fire
1.summary: While reporting a finished job to a villager, Alk and the others hear a scream. Rushing over, they meet Runetta, a red-haired girl who was rescuing an adventurer. Seeing her ideal adventurers in Alk and the others, Runetta asks to join them, and they take her to Starview Village.

lines.4: That completes the job, then. Now, if you'll sign this form--
lines.17: You're here to help!? I'm so happy! Thank you so much! ...Ah, may I ask your names--!
lines.21: Later! First, let's deal with these guys--!
lines.30: Nimbus, fall back! Let's clear her line of fire!
lines.35: Amazing... I didn't even say anything... Okay! As long as I don't have to worry about catching you in it--!
lines.47: I'm Runetta! When someone's in trouble, we all help each other! I'm glad I could save you!
lines.50: Thank you, Runetta... I'll repay this debt someday...
lines.54: Thank you all too! You were a huge help!
lines.57: You were really amazing! Lending a hand without a word in that situation...! And rescuing the injured so quickly...!
lines.61: ...That's first-class work, for sure! Are you famous adventurers or something!?
lines.64: Well... I guess we do know a lot of people like that, but--
lines.68: Amazing, amazing! So amazing! This must be fate!
lines.72: Please! Let me join your parrrty--
lines.103: You can talk after you eat. Take your time, okay?
lines.107: ...So, why do you want to join us?
lines.112: Yes, I'm aiming to become a first-class adventurer! But I'm still in training...
lines.116: Then you all showed up and moved like that! You're exactly the adventurers I dream of being! Please let me join you!
lines.121: If that's the case, you'd better steer clear of these guys.
lines.124: The two in charge are lunatics who'll charge to the ends of the world if something doesn't sit right with them. If you wanna make a name for yourself, anywhere else would be better.
lines.128: I don't care about success or money! I want to be with you all! You helped without saying a word...!
lines.132: Because I want to be like that too! An adventurer who can help every single person in trouble!
lines.136: I see, you're greedy. ...Well then, guess it's the usual from here, huh?
lines.140: Yes. Welcome to Starview Village, Runetta.
lines.145: Ah, but! Right now I'm no good at all! I can't control Mister Fire Spirit's power at all either...!
lines.150: ...So you are a spirit user. Are you from a village that worships spirits?
lines.154: No, it was just an ordinary farming village?
lines.157: Mister Fire Spirit lent me its power when I tried to save a village kid from a monster!
lines.160: A spirit...? Is it a being like Challua and the others--one you can communicate with?
lines.164: No! I don't really know about communicating! Mister Spirit is all floaty! But I could tell that's what it was doing!
lines.168: Hmm... Shywe would probably be pulling her hair out if she heard that...
lines.173: But thanks to that, I can help out with a lot more things than before!
lines.176: So I wanted to help even more people and aimed to become a first-class adventurer, but...
lines.180: ...When something unexpected happens, I panic right away!
lines.189: Yes, panic...! But I can't stay like this...!
lines.193: Ah... So that's why you needed companions. In that case--
lines.197: ...Ah!? Is it too presumptuous to ask to be a companion right away!?
lines.202: Then let's start with something like an attendant or apprentice!! Please! Masterrr!
lines.206: N-No, let's go with the companion thing, please...
lines.209: ...But if that's the case, it might work out pretty well, actually?
lines.220: Amazing, amazing, amaaazing! Is that a star? It's way too big, right!? Ah! I can see something! What's thaaat!?
lines.224: That's a world. A different world from the one you know-- We've been traveling through them.
lines.232: So that means I can help people all over the world, right!? Bring it on!
lines.237: Wow... You really are greedy. Welcome aboard, Runetta!
lines.241: Yes, it's a pleasure to be here!
lines.245: I'm getting all fired up! I'll definitely become a first-class adventurer...!
lines.250: Hey!? Runetta! Calm down! Fire, there's fire all around...!!
lines.255: Awawawa!! S-Sorry! I still can't control it...!!
lines.259: Her firepower's no joke... but neither is how scatterbrained she is...
lines.262: That just takes getting used to and the right approach. That's par for the course for us, isn't it?

2.title: The Way You Aim to Be
2.summary: Runetta has been taking on adventurer jobs without pay, and another adventurer warns her about it. Caught between her desire to help and his criticism, she returns to her roots, reflects on how she's been doing things, and vows to become a proper adventurer.

lines.9: A-All at once like that, are you okay...!?
lines.12: This is nothing! Should I put it behind the shop?
lines.15: You saved me. As for your reward--
lines.18: I do this because I like to, so I don't need any money! When someone's in trouble, we all help each other!
lines.21: Big Sis, play with me! Let's play tag!
lines.24: Okay! ...Ah, but! I still have work left, so let's play when I'm done!
lines.27: Okay! Then I'll wait in the square! Today I'm finally gonna get away from you, Big Sis!
lines.30: Hey, you've become really popular, huh?
lines.34: Ehehe... I'm happy everyone talks to me!
lines.37: Runetta, could you lend me a hand! I've got too much stuff and not enough hands!
lines.48: But today I'm helping you all with your shopping...
lines.51: Hey, we don't have that much to carry, and I think he needs it more. You want to help, right?
lines.56: Yes!! Then leave carrying the bags home to me!
lines.60: Okay, see you back here when you're done~
lines.66: ...Alright! I'll finish up fast and help Alk too...
lines.70: ...That's enough selling your skills for cheap.
lines.76: Helping people out with little things isn't bad. ...But you're an adventurer too, right?
lines.77: Then don't take on adventurer "work" like monster extermination and escort jobs for free.
lines.79: Adventurers aren't in the business of granting favors. There's a request, you get paid--that's how an adventurer's work keeps going round.
lines.80: If you take it on for free, we lose our jobs. That's a problem.
lines.89: Fwah!? Wh-When did you get here!?!?
lines.93: Uh, I just walked over normally...
lines.97: O-Oh, I see! So, what's going on!?!?
lines.100: Hmm. I figured it might be none of my business, but Nimbus said so too. ...Something happened, right?
lines.105: Can you read people's minds too, Alk!?!?
lines.109: It's written all over your face. You're not the type who can hide things, are you?
lines.114: Muuuu... That's just what my grandma back home says...
lines.119: Today... A senior adventurer told me...
lines.121: Not to take on everything for free, because they'd lose their jobs...
lines.130: I never realized I was causing trouble for other adventurers...
lines.134: Uuu... Am I a failure as an adventurer...?
lines.138: Hmm... You don't think it's okay to steal their jobs, right?
lines.143: B-But! Even if it's not a request, if someone's in trouble...!! I probably just can't leave them alone!
lines.147: So when that happens... I, I...!?!? Mmmmm...!?
lines.152: Uuu... Maybe someone like me can't become a first-class adventurer after all...?
lines.162: First-class is first-class...? ...Ah! Is this a question with a deeper meaning!?
lines.165: A question... No. It is not a riddle of any kind...?
lines.169: Runetta, why did you decide to become an adventurer?
lines.174: My hometown was a small village in the forest...
lines.176: A lot happened, and for some reason the power of fire came to dwell in me, but back then, I was pretty scared...
lines.184: I mean, it's surrounded by forest! If my power went out of control, it'd be a disaster.
lines.187: And even if it didn't... I thought everyone would be afraid of me, having such dangerous power...
lines.190: But... everyone in the village accepted me and helped me... And that made me so happy...!
lines.194: That's right! I wanted to share that feeling with other people too, so I set out to become an adventurer...!
lines.197: Ignoring people in trouble would defeat the whole purpose! So I--!
lines.201: Auuu... Th-Thinking so hard... made me hungry...
lines.205: ...I can whip up something simple right away?
lines.220: Yes! To become a full-fledged adventurer and help lots of people, I need energy!!
lines.224: Is that what a first-class adventurer is?
lines.228: Yes!! The way I've been doing things was a failure as an adventurer... I've reflected on that...!
lines.230: But if I become a proper adventurer and properly take on requests, I can help lots of people, right?
lines.234: Then that's what I'll aim for! Because... I set out to become an adventurer to help people in trouble with this power!

3.title: The Fire of Kindness Spreads
3.summary: In the labyrinth, Runetta runs into adventurers fighting to protect people from Shibuya. Unable to abandon the injured adventurers, she leaves Alk and the others to hold the line and rushes to the Guild. There, she secures reinforcements by posting an emergency request, and she treats the adventurers who helped to drinks as their reward.

lines.4: Thanks for helping today. Here's your share.
lines.7: Okay, thank you! Let's go on another adventure together!
lines.10: Runetta, are you free tomorrow? Truth is, my next job looks like a bit of a hassle... Of course, I'll pay you well.
lines.13: An equal split is fine! See you tomorrow!
lines.21: Ah, Alk! Nimbus! Are you going on an adventure now?
lines.25: Yeah. Just into the labyrinth for a bit. ...Will you help us?
lines.35: You're getting the hang of controlling your power. What do you say? Wanna try going a little deeper today--
lines.43: Wh-Whoaaa...!? What is this, what's going on...!!
lines.45: Wh-What the hell! Where even is this...!?
lines.47: Reinforcements!? Perfect timing! Lend us a hand...!!
lines.50: We'll take over...! You all evacuate the injured and the stranded!!
lines.53: --Our comrade's badly hurt. If we move him carelessly, the wound will open up...
lines.56: Th-Then let's take care of that first...!?
lines.59: L-Leave us behind... I've been ready to die in the labyrinth ever since I became an adventurer...
lines.60: ...But we can't drag them into this too, after they were suddenly thrown into some unknown place...
lines.62: ...That's how it is. We'll hold the rear. You take them and--
lines.74: No... It's not about what you want...!!
lines.78: I don't want it, and that's that! Maybe your judgment as adventurers is right!
lines.82: But if I abandon you here, there's no point in me being me!
lines.88: Alk, Nimbus! Please...! Help me think of a way to save everyone!
lines.91: ...Yeah. Got it. We'll hold out here, so Runetta--!!
lines.96: Excuse me! Somebody, please lend me a hand!!
lines.99: E-Every second counts! Anyone who's free, please go to the labyrinth...!!
lines.103: ...Please! Somebody...! Somebody, lend me your strength...!
lines.109: Ah! You're the one from before...!?
lines.112: First, explain the actual situation! I can't make heads or tails of what you just said!!
lines.114: ...Also, this is the Adventurers' Guild. If you want help, there's a faster way than begging, isn't there?
lines.123: I'm putting out a rescue "request" to everyone here!!
lines.126: The location is the labyrinth's middle floors! Injured people and drifters are trapped there! I'm looking for people to go rescue them!
lines.130: I'll pay as much as you want! Everything I have...!
lines.138: Okie-dokie★ If it's an emergency, the details can wait, so just sign here★
lines.142: All set♪ Now it's an official request! I'm posting it!!
lines.145: ...If it's a request, we should take it, right? As adventurers.
lines.147: And with a reward, I've got no complaints! Alright, you lot, let's get fired up!!
lines.150: ...That was the last of them. We should be fine for a while.
lines.152: Don't let your guard down. Bring the injured over here.
lines.155: Runetta! It's all okay now! Thanks to you, everyone was saved...!
lines.168: I made that request in the heat of the moment, but when I think about it, I don't have enough money to pay everyone...!!
lines.172: Wh-Wh-What do I do!? Can I put it on a tab!?
lines.180: Don't worry about it. You helped us out before, right? Call it our thanks for that.
lines.182: If you insist, then help us on our next adventure. ...For free!
lines.185: Fw-Fweh...? B-But! A request needs a proper reward...!!
lines.188: ...Come have a drink with me tonight. You can pick up the tab.
lines.189: For a request like this, that's just the right reward.
lines.200: Ah...! But I can't drink alcohol! ...Oh, how about milk!?
lines.203: Idiot!! At times like this, you just keep quiet and nod!
lines.206: O-Oh, is that how it works! O-Okay...!
lines.209: Hey, hey. If there's an after-party, take us along too!
lines.211: Oh, I won't make you pay, okay? It's a celebration for completing the mission!
lines.214: ...Okay! Then let's all have a party!!

1111153/1.19:
A newbie adventurer from the countryside. She harbors the power of a fire spirit, though even she doesn't really know why. But she doesn't sweat the details.

Armed with the spirit's power and her natural cheerfulness, she charges down the path to becoming a first-class adventurer.
